stores.title: Find your store. Sign in at the till.
stores.desc: Every active 1pos store is listed here. Pick yours to open its sign-in screen — owners, managers and cashiers all come in through the same door.
stores.directoryDesc: The @handle is the store's address — it's what you'll see in the link after you sign in.

stores.noStoresDesc: Nobody has opened a store on this platform yet. Yours can be the first.
stores.noMatchDesc: Check the spelling, or try the city or the @handle instead.
stores.ctaDesc: Owners can open one in a few minutes: add products, print a test receipt, ring up a real sale. Free for 14 days, no card needed.
stores.staffDesc: Ask your owner or manager for the store's @handle and look it up above. Cashier and manager logins are added by them from inside the store — you don't sign up here.

home.heroTagline: Ring it up. Print the OR. Close the drawer.
home.heroDesc: 1pos runs your counter, stockroom, and BIR paperwork from one browser tab — across every branch, and it keeps selling when the internet drops.
home.noCC: No credit card required · 14-day free trial · Cancel anytime
home.trustedBy: Live on the platform right now
home.spActiveStoresDesc: Active stores in your connected database (not explicitly disabled)
home.spActiveStoresDescZero: No tenants yet — use Sign up to create your first store (this count reads the same MongoDB as Browse Stores).
home.featuresDesc: From the cash drawer to the VAT summary, it ships in the box. Tap any tile to see what is inside.
home.posBody: Full POS with cart, barcode scanning, multiple payment methods, and BIR-compliant official receipt printing.
home.inventoryBody: Real-time stock tracking across branches, automatic deductions on sale, low-stock alerts, and transfer management.
home.reportsBody: Daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports, P&L statements, VAT summaries, and exportable data in CSV, Excel, or PDF.
home.highlightsDesc: After you lock up, 1pos closes the drawer, chases forgotten clock-outs, and puts yesterday’s numbers in your inbox before you open.
home.multiTenantDesc: Complete data isolation with tenant-specific branding, settings, and configurations. Perfect for SaaS deployments and enterprise solutions.
home.realTimeSyncDesc: Real-time inventory updates, stock validation, and Server-Sent Events for instant synchronization across all devices and locations.
home.automatedDesc: Seven core workflows today — booking reminders, low stock alerts, receipt email, scheduled reports, auto clock-out, cash drawer close, and customer welcome messages.
home.solutionsHeading: Set up for how you sell
home.solutionsDesc: Pick Retail for a product-heavy shop, or General if you sell a bit of everything — the right features switch on for you.
home.ecommerceDesc: Bridge your POS with Shopify or WooCommerce: sync catalog and inventory, import paid web orders, and push stock updates — with encrypted credentials and tenant-controlled toggles.
home.ecommerceShopifyBody: Secure OAuth, expiring offline tokens, catalog sync, inventory levels at your default location, paid order import, and webhooks — so your storefront and counter stay aligned.
home.ecommerceWooBody: Connect your WordPress store with REST keys: pull products, map SKUs to POS items, push available quantity after sales, and process order webhooks with HMAC verification.
home.ecommerceCard1Body: When you sell in-store or online, stock updates flow to the other channel so you avoid overselling.
home.ecommerceCard2Body: Link channel variants to POS products by SKU, pull product data, and keep listings aligned with one click.
home.ecommerceCard3Body: Paid Shopify orders and qualifying WooCommerce orders can create POS transactions with idempotent handling.
home.saveTimeDesc: Seven core automations cut repetitive tasks (booking reminders, low stock, receipts, reports, and more)
home.increaseRevenueDesc: Advanced analytics help identify growth opportunities
home.scaleEasilyDesc: Multi-tenant architecture grows with your business
home.testimonialsDesc: Owners and managers on what changed after they switched.
home.testimonial1Quote: 1pos transformed how we run our retail chain. The real-time inventory and multi-branch reporting paid for itself within the first month.
home.testimonial2Quote: The automated workflows alone save my team 3+ hours every day — reminders, stock alerts, and scheduled reports just run themselves.
home.testimonial3Quote: We replaced three separate tools with 1pos. Bookings, customer CRM, and POS all in one platform is an absolute game changer.
home.ctaDesc: Add your products, print a test receipt, ring up a real sale. Free for 14 days — no card needed.
home.ctaNoCC: No credit card required · 14-day free trial · Cancel anytime
home.footerDesc: BIR-ready enterprise POS with 23 capability modules for modern Philippine businesses.
home.footerCopyright: © 2026 DevCom Digital Marketing Services. 1POS is a product of DevCom.
home.footerTagline: BIR-ready POS · 23 modules · 2 languages · Built for the Philippines
home.nightStockDesc: Items under their reorder point get flagged before tomorrow’s rush.
home.nightClockoutDesc: Staff who left without clocking out are closed out, so payroll hours stay honest.
home.nightReceiptDesc: Customers who left an email address get their receipt automatically.
home.nightDrawerDesc: Any cash drawer left open is closed and its count checked against expected cash.
home.nightReportDesc: Yesterday’s sales by branch, waiting in your inbox before you open.
home.ccDesc: Same till, set up differently — here is what each kind of store leans on most.
home.ccSariDesc: Big tap-keys for best-sellers, a cash drawer that counts itself, and a low-stock alert before the softdrinks run out.
home.ccCafeDesc: Ring up an order in seconds, take cash, card, or e-wallet, and print the OR while the espresso pulls.
home.ccBoutiqueDesc: Sizes and colours as variations, barcode labels you print yourself, and stock that follows transfers between branches.
home.ccSpecialtyDesc: Customer profiles, purchase history, and discount codes with usage limits — so regulars feel like regulars.
home.ccNightDesc: Shift clock-ins, a drawer session per cashier, and offline mode for when the line drops at 3 AM.
home.ccCardDesc: Every tender recorded against the drawer, and every refund put back into stock automatically.

pricing.title: One monthly price per store.
pricing.desc: Every new store starts on a 14-day free trial — no card needed. Pick a plan when the trial ends; you can move up as you add staff and branches.
pricing.noSetupFee: No setup fee on any plan
pricing.errorDesc: Check your connection and try again.
pricing.compareDesc: Limits are checked by the till itself — a store that reaches one has to move up a plan to go past it.
pricing.ctaDesc: Ring up real sales for 14 days. If you need more branches, staff or BIR paperwork than a plan allows, tell us what your counter looks like.

contact.title: Something wrong at the counter? Email us.
contact.desc: One inbox handles setup questions, billing and problems with a sale.
contact.slipNote: The OR number is printed on the receipt and shown in Transactions. It lets us find the exact sale.
contact.routesTitle: You may not need to write at all
contact.routeFindBody: Look it up by name, city or @handle and go straight to its sign-in screen.
contact.routePriceBody: Monthly prices, staff and branch limits, and what BIR help each plan includes.
contact.routeOpenBody: Sign up yourself — the 14-day trial starts right away, no card needed.
contact.routePrivacyBody: Access, correction or deletion of personal data goes to our privacy inbox.
